sections.content: To say 'my X', Hungarian adds a possessive suffix to the noun rather than using a separate word for 'my'. terv ('plan') plus -m gives tervem ('my plan').

items.english: I have a plan. (lit. 'There is my plan.')

sections.content: This is the same pattern as jegyünk ('our ticket') from an earlier unit -- only the ending changes to match who owns it. -m for 'my' works after most nouns ending in a vowel; consonant-final nouns often need a linking vowel first, as in programom.
